title: Sri Pantham Satyanarayana Prirmary school
description: Sri Pantham Satyanarayana Primary School — a vibrant learning environment designed to inspire creativity and community engagement.
notes: Sri Pantham Satyanarayana Primary School brings together color, play, and functionality to create a lively and child-friendly educational space. The building’s bold use of red, teal, and grey panels introduces a modern aesthetic while maintaining warmth and approachability. Open corridors, shaded play zones, and landscaped pockets encourage interaction and movement, making the school an active, engaging space for young minds. Designed for the Vijayawada Municipal Corporation, the project reflects a vision of inclusive education through thoughtful architecture that blends urban functionality with playful design expression.
